root_interpretation: The ten success cases, including delegated exit, matched the currently implemented status/cell checks. All seven real refusals had correct raw revert payloads, but shared parser blocked them and vault scorer incorrectly converted blocked into fail. This is a harness defect, not seven source-semantic counterexamples. Current consumer should report blocked3 for unclassified observations; proper repair must classify and compare structured refusal bytes and maintain fail-closed behavior.

Support the required revert payload grammar via real shared consumer while preserving strict success width, duplicate/empty/unknown handling and accepted P16 regressions. Decode and compare the expected specific error, not any revert.
